summary: Editas Medicine filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 55,555,556 shares of common stock and accompanying warrants at a combined price of $2.25 per unit, targeting gross proceeds of $125 million. The warrants have an exercise price of $3.50 and expire upon a Phase 1 data announcement or three years. The filing is a routine capital raise on Form 424B5, not a special situation. The last sale price was $2.76 on May 22, 2026. Underwriters include Cantor and Wells Fargo. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown, not an event-driven special situation. Watch for stock dilution and warrant overhang post-offering.
